name: Sensei! Aegasete♪
source:
Advisers constantly change in this school's broadcasting club. Main character is appointed as the next one. He seeks consultation from previous adviser in attempt to learn the truth behind the mysterious club members...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这所学校的广播社不断更换指导老师，主人公被任命为下一任顾问。为弄清社员们为何如此神秘，他找到了前任顾问，希望从对方口中获知真相……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
